$SLOIF / $SOI Soitec is down 70%+ from its peak. The market is pricing it as a dying smartphone wafer supplier. That’s wrong.

Soitec is the only volume-qualified supplier of Photonics-SOI wafers, the substrate that every silicon photonics chip for AI data centers is built on. TSMC, Tower Semi, and GlobalFoundries are all qualified on Soitec. Nobody else is. You cannot build optical interconnect chips at scale without them.

The selloff is 100% inventory-driven. Post-COVID phone customers over-ordered. The correction is already reversing: Q2 FY26 +51% sequential, Q3 +18%, Q4 guided +20%.

The real catalyst stack: Tower Semi is 5x-ing photonics capacity in 2026, already 70%+ spoken for. TSMC silicon photonics packaging enters production H2 2026. Skyworks signed a multi-year POI wafer deal March 4. Simgui 10-year supply extension signed March 13. EU FAMES project brings 830M euros in funding for next-gen FD-SOI.

The operating leverage is the alpha. Soitec spent 1.1 billion euros building its factories. That capex is done, dropping from 230M to ~100M maintenance. Current utilization is below 60%. Every photonics wafer sold from here hits a near-fixed cost base. Margins will be violent on the recovery.

4,300+ patents. Smart Cut is 30 years of trade secrets. Chip fabs need 12-24 months to re-qualify a new supplier, there is zero switching. Soitec just won its IP lawsuit against GlobalWafers. The moat is legally enforced.

The market sees a cyclical. The reality is an AI photonics monopoly with an underutilized billion-dollar fab and a recovering order book.

DYOR. This is not financial advice.
